inline_external_table.sql: SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL ((c NUMBER, d VARCHAR2(10)) TYPE ORACLE_LOADER DEFAULT DIRECTORY dir ACCESS PARAMETERS (RECORDS DELIMITED BY NEWLINE FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',') LOCATION ('f.csv') REJECT LIMIT UNLIMITED) x;

lateral.sql: SELECT x.c FROM t, LATERAL (SELECT c FROM u WHERE u.id = t.id) x;

partition_for.sql: SELECT c FROM t PARTITION FOR (100);

partition_with_alias.sql: SELECT x.c FROM t PARTITION (p1) x;

subpartition_for.sql: SELECT c FROM t SUBPARTITION FOR (100, 'A');

subquery_with_check_option.sql: SELECT c FROM (SELECT c FROM t WITH CHECK OPTION CONSTRAINT ck);

subquery_with_read_only.sql: SELECT c FROM (SELECT c FROM t WITH READ ONLY);

table_collection.sql: SELECT x.* FROM t, TABLE(t.arr) x;

table_collection_cast_multiset.sql: SELECT x.* FROM t, TABLE(CAST(MULTISET(SELECT c FROM u WHERE u.id = t.id) AS typ)) x;

table_collection_outer.sql: SELECT x.* FROM t, TABLE(t.arr) (+) x;

qualify.sql: SELECT c, s FROM t QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY s DESC) = 1;

qualify_after_group_by.sql: SELECT c, AVG(s) FROM t GROUP BY c HAVING c IS NOT NULL QUALIFY AVG(s) < 2000;

qualify_alias.sql: SELECT c, AVG(s) OVER w AS a FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c) QUALIFY a > 10 ORDER BY c;

qualify_without_analytic.sql: SELECT s FROM t WHERE c IS NOT NULL QUALIFY s < 2000;

window_clause.sql: SELECT c, AVG(s) OVER w FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY d);

window_clause_frame.sql: SELECT c, FIRST_VALUE(s) OVER w FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING);

window_clause_multiple.sql: SELECT c, AVG(s) OVER w1, SUM(s) OVER w2 FROM t WINDOW w1 AS (PARTITION BY c), w2 AS (PARTITION BY d);

window_existing_name.sql: SELECT c, SUM(s) OVER (w ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c);

column_aliases.sql: WITH q (a, b) AS (SELECT c, d FROM t) SELECT a, b FROM q;

cte.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q;

cycle.sql: WITH q (id, pid) AS (SELECT id, pid FROM t WHERE pid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.pid FROM q, t WHERE q.id = t.pid) CYCLE id SET is_cycle TO 'Y' DEFAULT 'N' SELECT id, is_cycle FROM q;

multiple.sql: WITH q1 AS (SELECT c FROM t), q2 AS (SELECT c FROM q1 WHERE c > 0) SELECT c FROM q2;

nested_with.sql: WITH q AS (WITH r AS (SELECT 1 c FROM DUAL) SELECT c FROM r) SELECT c FROM q;

plsql_function.sql: WITH FUNCTION f(x NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS BEGIN RETURN x * 2; END; SELECT f(c) FROM t;

plsql_function_with_cte.sql: WITH FUNCTION f(x NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS BEGIN RETURN x; END; q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT f(c) FROM q;

plsql_procedure_and_function.sql: WITH PROCEDURE p(x NUMBER) IS BEGIN NULL; END; FUNCTION f(x NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS BEGIN p(x); RETURN x; END; SELECT f(c) FROM t;

recursive.sql: WITH q (n) AS (SELECT 1 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM q WHERE n < 10) SELECT n FROM q;

search_breadth_first.sql: WITH q (id, pid) AS (SELECT id, pid FROM t WHERE pid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.pid FROM q, t WHERE q.id = t.pid) SEARCH BREADTH FIRST BY id DESC NULLS LAST SET ord SELECT id FROM q ORDER BY ord;

search_depth_first.sql: WITH q (id, pid) AS (SELECT id, pid FROM t WHERE pid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.pid FROM q, t WHERE q.id = t.pid) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY id SET ord SELECT id FROM q ORDER BY ord;

subav_factoring.sql: WITH a ANALYTIC VIEW AS (USING av HIERARCHIES (h) ADD MEASURES (m2 AS (LAG(m) OVER (HIERARCHY h OFFSET 1)))) SELECT h.member_name, m, m2 FROM a HIERARCHIES (h);

subav_filter_fact.sql: WITH a ANALYTIC VIEW AS (USING av HIERARCHIES (h) FILTER FACT (h TO level_name = 'YEAR')) SELECT m FROM a HIERARCHIES (h);

values.sql: WITH x (a, b) AS (VALUES (1, 2), (3, 4)) SELECT a, b FROM x;

with_in_subquery.sql: SELECT c FROM t WHERE c > (WITH q AS (SELECT AVG(c) a FROM t) SELECT a FROM q);

list_deferred.sql: SET CONSTRAINTS c1, c2, c3 DEFERRED;

all_except.sql: SET ROLE ALL EXCEPT r1, r2;

multiple_roles.sql: SET ROLE r1, r2 IDENTIFIED BY pw;

role_identified_by.sql: SET ROLE r IDENTIFIED BY pw;

isolation_read_committed.sql: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

read_only_name.sql: SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY NAME 'West Coast';

use_rollback_segment.sql: SET TRANSACTION USE ROLLBACK SEGMENT rbs_one;

disabled.sql: SET USE DATA GRANTS ONLY ON hr.employees DISABLED;

enabled.sql: SET USE DATA GRANTS ONLY ON hr.employees ENABLED;

drop_all_storage.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE t DROP ALL STORAGE;

preserve_mview_log.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE t PRESERVE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG;

purge_mview_log.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE t PURGE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG;

alias.sql: UPDATE s.t x SET x.c = 1 WHERE x.id = 2;

basic.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE id = 2;

column_list_expressions.sql: UPDATE t SET (c, d) = (1, DEFAULT) WHERE id = 2;

column_list_subquery.sql: UPDATE t a SET (c, d) = (SELECT AVG(c), AVG(d) FROM u b WHERE a.id = b.id) WHERE a.k = 1;

dblink.sql: UPDATE t@remote SET c = c * 1.1 WHERE d = 'x';

from_clause.sql: UPDATE t SET t.c = u.c FROM u WHERE u.id = t.id;

from_join.sql: UPDATE t SET t.c = u.c FROM u JOIN v ON u.id = v.id WHERE u.id = t.id;

hint.sql: UPDATE /*+ INDEX(t idx) */ t SET c = 1 WHERE id = 2;

log_errors.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c + 1 LOG ERRORS INTO errlog ('upd') REJECT LIMIT UNLIMITED;

mixed_set.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1, (d, e) = (SELECT d, e FROM u WHERE u.id = 1) WHERE id = 2;

multiple_columns.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c + 1, d = 'x', e = DEFAULT WHERE id = 2;

nowait.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE id = 2 NOWAIT;

order_by.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c + 1 WHERE d > 0 ORDER BY id;

partition.sql: UPDATE t PARTITION (p1) x SET x.c = 1 WHERE d > 10;

partition_for.sql: UPDATE t PARTITION FOR (100) SET c = 1;

return_into.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE id = 2 RETURN c INTO :b1;

returning_aggregate.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c * 1.1 WHERE d = 100 RETURNING SUM(c) INTO :b1;

returning_into.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c + 1 WHERE id = 2 RETURNING c * 2, d INTO :b1, :b2;

returning_old_new.sql: UPDATE t SET c = c + 1 WHERE id = 2 RETURNING OLD c, NEW c INTO :b1, :b2;

scalar_subquery.sql: UPDATE t SET c = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM u WHERE u.id = t.id);

set_value.sql: UPDATE t p SET VALUE(p) = (SELECT VALUE(q) FROM u q WHERE p.id = q.id) WHERE p.id = 10;

subquery_target.sql: UPDATE (SELECT c FROM t WHERE d > 0) SET c = 1;

subquery_target_check_option.sql: UPDATE (SELECT c, d FROM t WHERE d > 0 WITH CHECK OPTION) SET c = 1;

table_collection.sql: UPDATE TABLE(SELECT h.people FROM h WHERE h.id = 1) p SET p.salary = p.salary + 100;

using_clause.sql: UPDATE t SET t.c = u.c USING u WHERE u.id = t.id;

wait_seconds.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE id = 2 WAIT 10 SECONDS;

set_attribute.sql: UPDATE END_USER_CONTEXT t SET t.CONTEXT.emp_id = 3 WHERE owner = 'HR' AND name = 'HCM';
